supporting_observations.claim: The failed svc-claimsync network logons recur at roughly one-minute intervals from FILE-HD-01, with WorkstationName=FILE-HD-01, source IP 10.30.20.20, and the same LSASS process. Examples span 13:31 through 13:46 UTC.

The failures report an incorrect password: the FILE-HD-01 4625 records show SubStatus=0xc000006a, while corresponding domain-controller records show bad-preauthentication status 0x18 or bad-password status 0xc000006a.

The observed cadence and source are consistent with the inventory-described ClaimSync job re-authenticating each minute on FILE-HD-01 and the scheduled 13:30 UTC password rotation leaving the job with a stale password. The records do not, by themselves, establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:46 UTC, so they do not cover the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The supplied records do not show the password rotation, the manual ClaimSync job update, or the job's configuration and execution logs.
claims_not_established: Whether the ClaimSync job was updated with the rotated password, or whether its stale credential fully explains the failures.
Whether any svc-claimsync authentication succeeded during the remainder of the requested window.
Whether the separate explicit-credentials event on WS-LPARK-01 is connected to the FILE-HD-01 failure sequence.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-LPARK-01 recorded a SYSTEM-process explicit-credentials event using svc-claimsync to target PROXY-HD-01, with process C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe. The supplied context does not establish a connection to the FILE-HD-01 failed-logon sequence; do not use this event alone to determine this alert. (T002-00019)
